value.body: A two-year M.Sc run by the National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology (NCHMCT) at a group of central Institutes of Hotel Management, with the degree awarded by JNU. It covers hospitality management, finance, human resources, research methods and teaching skills.

items.label: PG enrolment in hospitality administration
items.note: All PG years, as reported to AISHE
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, PG enrolment by subject, based on actual responses (Ministry of Education)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree from a recognised university, as listed in NCHMCT's notice. Most candidates take NCHMCT's M.Sc entrance test; graduates with a full-time hospitality degree (55%) and two years' experience in hotels rated three-star or above can get direct admission.

value.title: At a glance
items: It is often taken by those aiming for teaching posts at IHMs and hospitality colleges, as well as management roles.
For hotel operations jobs, employers often weigh experience as much as a master's degree.
Dates, fees and eligible degrees change each year, so the current NCHMCT notice is the rule that applies.
